text:
Type: simple low panel bench
Use: seating at a low table, a perch for putting on shoes; children's room, playroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: smooth white painted board, small plastic glides
Colors: pure white
Shape: flat rectangular seat on two solid side panels, slim rail under the seat, open underneath, plain square edges, low and compact
Feel: clean, simple, light, practical
Goes with: white or light wood furniture, pastel or bright accents; Scandinavian children's rooms and minimalist hallways

product.name: STUVA
product.description: You can transform the bench into an extra storage space by simply adding a storage box underneath, sold separately.
